name: agentic-kit
description: Personal Claude Code marketplace. Hosts the cmux-swarm, motion-trace, and design-eng plugins; the remaining loose skills ship as symlinks via install.sh.

plugins.name: cmux-swarm
plugins.description: Orchestrate a team of Claude Code agents in cmux (create-swarm) plus filtered code-check and visual-check skills and a cmux bootstrap command.

plugins.name: motion-trace
plugins.description: Review web animation as structured per-frame data (not video): easing, overshoot, prefers-reduced-motion accessibility, and real-runtime jank. MCP tools (discover/review/capture/diff) plus a motion-review skill.

plugins.name: design-eng
plugins.description: Design-engineering skills: ui-reverse-engineer (screenshot/URL → faithful reconstruction + design tokens), motion-system (design the motion layer — tokens, choreography, per-state transitions — inferred from taste or measured from video/URL), and figma-export (push tokens + components into Figma).
